teach.narration: Convert eighty percent to zero point eight. The efficiency reduces the actual mechanical advantage below the ideal value of four.

teach.title: Divide work by time
teach.narration: Spreading the work over sixty seconds gives eleven thousand two hundred and fifty joules each second.

teach.narration: Divide watts by one thousand to match the units of the choices.

steps.title: Find the friction force
steps.narration: For a horizontal push on a level road, friction must cancel the push to keep the speed and direction constant.

steps.title: Relate friction to reaction
steps.narration: The coefficient of kinetic friction is the friction force per unit of normal reaction.

steps.title: Calculate the coefficient
steps.narration: Divide the friction force by the normal reaction. The newton units cancel.
